issues.title: V3: Rebuild celestial depth and constellation-born Ziwei palace
issues.body:
V3 重构聚焦两件事：背景的宇宙纵深，以及紫微垣从原始星形中“长出”宫城。

- 重做纸张宇宙底层：新增矿物蓝 / 青灰 / 紫灰的分层星雾和斜向银河结构，不再使用单一光柱式效果。
- p5 动态层新增约 960 个沿银河带聚集的细星尘、260 个远景星点，以及极淡的弧形运行轨迹和移动亮点。
- 紫微垣不再叠加无关的宫殿图标：宫墙直接沿原本 15 个紫微垣星点生成。
- 从同一组星点派生内外两重垣墙、星点檐口、门阙与两端角楼；显影动画跟随星线逐段生长。
- 选中后其余星官退暗，紫微垣移动到视觉中心；说明文字改为更轻的底部展签。
- 其他星官暂时只保留与自身星形相关的轮廓回声，避免再次出现“意向插画与星形无关”的问题。
- 已验证 sketch.js / ui.js / music.js JavaScript 语法通过。

在线预览复制到 main/preview-v3，不影响正式页面。

issues.title: Redesign: immersive Dunhuang celestial atlas
issues.body:
这版不是小修，而是按“古纸上的活星图”方向重做交互视觉：

- 保留深色古纸底图，并显著加强纤维、斑驳与矿物颗粒纹理
- 加入冷色矿物渐变、细星雾、斜向银河星带、微弱星尘与星轨
- 点选星官后，其他星官退暗，目标星官平滑移动并放大到画面中央
- 新增“天象意向”线稿系统：紫微/紫微垣为半透明宫阙，北斗为帝车，华盖为车盖，文昌/尚书等为卷册，传舍为亭驿等
- 原左侧大段介绍改为底部居中的沉浸式说明层，避免遮挡中央星象
- 标题和页脚在进入星官详情时自动退场
- 保留原有 p5.js 星官数据、古籍说明、音乐与键盘交互
- 已做 JavaScript 语法检查（sketch.js / ui.js / music.js）

建议先看整体气质和“点选紫微垣”这一条核心交互，再决定下一轮把哪些星官的实体意向继续精雕。

pull_request_review_comments.body:
**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Keep current-sky stars in the horizon projection**

When the transition to `now` completes, this unconditionally fades `bakeAlpha` back to 1. However, `bakeSky()` creates a north-polar texture, and the frame loop then fades out `drawLiveMW()` and `drawLiveStars()`, which are the layers using the horizon/perspective projection. Within a few seconds, most stars and the Milky Way therefore revert to the polar chart and no longer align with the real Dunhuang sky, horizon, or perspectively drawn bright stars; keep the baked layer disabled in `now` mode or provide a separately projected live-view cache.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Close the scroll before entering current-sky mode**

When `scroll` is already true and the user presses “此刻敦煌”, this handler starts the mode transition without clearing the scroll state. Consequently `scrollK` remains 1, the opaque paper continues to cover the live view, and even the scroll's star geometry is transformed toward the horizon projection; the reverse flow explicitly returns to Tang mode before opening the scroll, so this direction should likewise close the scroll before switching modes.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Defer the tour while transitioning toward the live view**

If the user starts the tour during the 6.2-second Tang-to-`now` transition, `mode` is still `tang`, so this condition does not request a return; the existing transition then completes into `now` while the tour remains active. Tour selections are subsequently shown in the standing live-sky projection rather than the Tang polar chart the tour describes. Check `trans.toMode` and defer or reverse the transition before initializing the tour.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Remove hidden overlays from the keyboard tab order**

When the detail panel is closed, `aria-hidden="true"` and the panel's opacity/pointer-event styles do not prevent its close button from receiving sequential keyboard focus, so Tab moves onto an invisible control that is also absent from the accessibility tree. The tour section has the same problem for its three navigation buttons while inactive. Use `hidden`/`inert`, or explicitly manage descendant tab stops whenever these overlays are closed.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.
